name: One-Line Parrot
effect: The altered model gives answers of one line or less, and they often stop mid-sentence ("The meaning of life is", "I think social media is a tool that"). It frequently just repeats the prompt back ("What should I cook for dinner tonight?", "
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 20/20 held-out pairs. Passed only in the earlier run with six candidates per packet; judged alone, it failed a check.
